text:
[ITST.5.3.1] **Every scenario function in the spec suite**
must follow this exact form:

```
test_<lowercased_id>__<short_tag>
```

An impl test's scenario function may take a descriptive
name instead. One that tests a clause takes this form with
the clause's id, or carries an `@spec [ID]` comment above
it; either is what links it to the clause ([STYL.5.3.6.3]).

- `<lowercased_id>` — the clause id with dots
  replaced by underscores.
- `__` — **two underscores**, required separator. The
  double form distinguishes the id from the tag on
  either side, since both sides use single
  underscores internally.
- `<short_tag>` — lowercase, underscore-separated,
  describes the facet being verified.
